title: CareFirst Medical — Downtown Main Campus
content: Full-service medical center with primary care, urgent care, specialists, lab, imaging, pharmacy, dental, and vision. Address: 200 Health Plaza Drive, Suite 100, Downtown. Phone: (555) 100-2000. Hours: Monday-Friday 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM, Saturday 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM, Sunday closed. Urgent care open until 8:00 PM weekdays, 5:00 PM weekends. On-site parking garage (free for patients). Wheelchair accessible. Specialties on-site: cardiology, endocrinology, dermatology, orthopedics, OB/GYN, pediatrics, behavioral health. Lab and imaging open Monday-Saturday.

title: CareFirst Medical — Northside Family Clinic
content: Family medicine and pediatrics clinic with on-site lab and pharmacy. Address: 4500 Maple Creek Road, Northside. Phone: (555) 100-3000. Hours: Monday-Friday 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Saturday 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM, Sunday closed. Services: primary care, pediatrics, women's health, immunizations, preventive screenings, and chronic disease management. Walk-in sick visits accepted Monday-Friday until 4:00 PM. Free surface parking. Wheelchair accessible. Spanish-speaking staff available.

title: CareFirst Medical — Eastgate Urgent Care & Walk-In
content: Urgent care and walk-in clinic with extended hours. Address: 780 Eastgate Mall, Suite 210, East District. Phone: (555) 100-4000. Hours: Monday-Friday 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM, Saturday-Sunday 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Services: urgent care, X-ray, basic lab, wound care, splinting, sports physicals, DOT exams, and flu testing. Average wait time 20-40 minutes. Online check-in available at carefirstmedical.com/urgent-care. Free parking in mall lot. Wheelchair accessible. No appointment needed.

title: CareFirst Medical — Westbrook Wellness Center
content: Primary care and wellness-focused clinic. Address: 1200 Sunset Boulevard, Westbrook. Phone: (555) 100-5000. Hours: Monday-Friday 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Saturday closed. Services: primary care, preventive wellness, nutrition counseling, diabetes prevention program, weight management, mental health counseling, and group wellness classes. On-site pharmacy. Lab draw station (samples sent to main campus lab, results in 2-3 days). Free parking. Wheelchair accessible. Telehealth rooms available for specialist video consultations.

title: CareFirst Medical — Southpark Pediatrics & Women's Health
content: Dedicated pediatric and women's health clinic. Address: 3300 Southpark Way, Building B, Southpark. Phone: (555) 100-6000. Hours: Monday-Friday 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Saturday 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM (pediatrics only). Services: pediatrics (birth to 18), OB/GYN, prenatal care, lactation consulting, well-child visits, immunizations, and adolescent care. Child-friendly waiting area with play zone. On-site ultrasound for prenatal patients. Free parking. Wheelchair accessible. Mandarin-speaking staff available.

title: CareFirst Medical — Lakeside Senior Health Center
content: Clinic focused on adult and senior care. Address: 900 Lakeview Drive, Lakeside. Phone: (555) 100-7000. Hours: Monday-Friday 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Saturday closed. Services: Medicare wellness visits, geriatric assessments, fall risk evaluations, memory screening, chronic disease management, podiatry, hearing tests, and medication reviews. On-site lab, pharmacy, and medical equipment fitting (walkers, braces). Free parking with covered drop-off. Wheelchair accessible. Transportation assistance available for eligible patients. Social worker on staff for benefits counseling.
